description: This file defines the JavelinGuardrail class, which extends CustomGuardrail, and manages interactions with the Javelin guard API including calling the API, handling responses, and integrating guardrail checks into a larger system. It includes methods for making asynchronous API requests, preprocessing data before calls, and handling guardrail violations by raising HTTP exceptions.
